name: DRAFT Kubler 2023 vine robot cPAM W40 x L40

source.detail: digitized: Kubler et al. 2023 (arXiv:2305.00967v3) Fig 7, cPAM W40 x L40: top row quasi-static bending (data mean) + bottom row lateral force with tip fixed

metadata.notes: DRAFT -- not reviewed, not in the manifest. cPAM W40 x L40 mm actuator line on a soft growing (everting) vine robot. Measured MOUNTED ON AN INFLATED VINE BODY (diameter 80 mm, body length 420 mm, body pressure 1.75 kPa), not as a free-standing actuator: the curves describe actuator plus inflated beam. Materials: 70 denier ripstop nylon with one-sided TPU coating; cylindrical pneumatic artificial muscles welded into the vine body. Free motion: the paper reports bending angle per nominal length (deg/cm; data mean of five runs, horizontal configuration, Fig 7 top row). Converted here to tip displacement ASSUMING one circular arc of constant curvature over the actuated length L = 360 mm (paper Table 1), inextensible centreline, the remaining 60 mm of body ignored. That unactuated part is at the tip end (paper Fig 3 side view), so the port here is the end of the actuated length: the vine's physical tip lies a further 60 mm along the final tangent and moves more than this port, and the force sensor held that physical tip. Frame X base->tip, bending toward +Y. At the last level (30.1 kPa) b = 1.607 deg/cm, i.e. 57.8 deg total turn. Free levels start at 6 kPa: below that the curve runs under other series and could not be traced. free_direction is rest -> lowest digitised level. Blocked force: the front (tip) of the vine robot was fixed to an ATI Nano-17 six-axis force-torque sensor and the lateral force (perpendicular to the growing axis) reported, mean of five runs at ten pressures (Fig 7 bottom row); recorded as force_transverse_N. The paper does not report the axial component, so force_axial_N is null; the workshop loader then reads no push force from this record (same as the Mosadegh records). Reading error (kubler2023_fig7_reading_error.json): about 0.0040 deg/cm on bend (about 0.34 mm of tip Y at the last level) and 0.0112 N on force; the paper's own run-to-run SD is larger (CSV columns band_lo/band_hi and force_sd_N). Polarity_axial null: bender, not an axial actuator.

input.energy_convention: mechanical work delivered at the input port (J)

port.name: tip
port.description: end of the actuated length (vine robot tip region)
